original_test_intent: Validate Permanent Fault Detection in125-bit ECC mode by showing that the configured continuous UCE is corrected and recorded in the target IMC/retry path, corrected count, serial and OS trace.
original_method: Record platform/baseline; enable PFD and Directory Mode; halt and confirm125-bit ECC; reset injector lock and apply literal dev0/dev1 masks; run one approved continuous UCE command at0x8000 with immediate consumption; capture target IMC status, retry log1 and corrected-count delta, serial corrected signal and FTrace; stop injector/recover through owner procedure, restore knobs and verify health.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates125-bit PFD mode, mask/address and corrected-field oracle, controls continuous injection/abort and recovery while the agent correlates captured evidence.
required_inputs: CScripts version/hash/license and PFD/Directory path mapping
Confirmed125-bit ECC output and address0x8000 target mapping
Exact mask semantics, IMC/retry fields and corrected-counter baseline/expected delta
Continuous-injector stop method, serial/FTrace timing and OOB recovery/restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Reject any mode other than approved125-bit ECC or preexisting unexplained errors
Arm continuous injection once with immediate stop/abort capability
Stop on unexpected UC state, wrong bank/address, nonincrementing/overrunning counter or instability
Preserve evidence; restore PFD/directory/debug/injection settings and verify health
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved ECC mode, mask, mapping and oracle
Observe one controlled continuous-injection window and collect exact register/trace evidence
Do not select mask, start/retry/leave injector running independently or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve mask and corrected field/counter oracle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Coverage mismatch: dmesg/SEL tails do not prove125-bit ECC, the literal mask, continuous/immediate-consume semantics or IMC/retry count.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain `show_ecc_modes`, exact mask0x0000_7013_0000_0000, one approved `injectMemError(0x8000,immConsume=True,oneInjection=False,errType="uce")`, IMC/retry/counter, serial and FTrace capture.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PFD/Directory enable,125-bit mode, mask/address/flags, target paths, trace and30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Confirm125-bit mode, run one bounded continuous-UCE observation using the exact mask and correlate PFD correction across IMC, retry, count, serial and trace surfaces.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds bounded continuous-injector interlock, immutable counter baseline and audited restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic corrected log cannot show that PFD in125-bit mode corrected the prescribed fault pattern.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Continuous UCE injection can rapidly accumulate errors or hang the platform; the mask/target and stop method are platform-specific.

project_override_considerations: The test name says125 Bit and the source command calls `show_ecc_modes`; engineering must approve exact output spelling/encoding and why directory mode yields the intended mode. Do not normalize to the adjacent128b case.
expected_evidence: Target IMC status and retry log1 showing corrected handling
Corrected-error counter baseline/delta, serial corrected signal and FTrace
Post-test health, injector stopped, settings restored and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, BIOS setup and injection flow consistently exercise PFD under125-bit ECC, despite minor source typos not affecting test meaning.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The125-bit recipe, harness and oracle are supplyable prerequisites; no inherent source impossibility is established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row171 Wistron-System RAS-00128-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology, CScripts version/hash/license, PFD and Directory Mode mappings and exact show_ecc_modes125-bit oracle; provide address0x8000 target, mask0x0000_7013_0000_0000 semantics, expected IMC/retry/corrected-counter/serial/FTrace fields, bounded continuous-injector stop rule and OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Distinguishes125-bit PFD from the adjacent128b CE baseline, preserves the continuous fault mechanics and makes the cross-surface corrected result attributable to one bounded injection window.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same physical error mask has different correctability depending on ECC encoding, so mode proof is part of the oracle rather than setup trivia. A continuous UCE with immediate consumption stresses PFD, but only a bounded interval can be safely attributed. IMC/retry records show controller handling, the counter delta shows accounting, and serial/FTrace show reporting. All must align in time; generic corrected text would not prove the intended mode or mask.
